name: Securities Account
definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

SecuritiesAccountType.name: Securities Account Type
SecuritiesAccountType.definition: Specifies the type of securities account.

RelatedInvestmentAccount.name: Related Investment Account
RelatedInvestmentAccount.definition: Investment account which contains a securities account to make securities movements.

RelatedTransfer.name: Related Transfer
RelatedTransfer.definition: Specifies the process which moves securities out of an account to another one.

SecuritiesPartyRole.name: Securities Party Role
SecuritiesPartyRole.definition: Specifies the role which uses a securities account.

Security.name: Security
Security.definition: Security which is held on the securities account.

RelatedRegistrar.name: Related Registrar
RelatedRegistrar.definition: Specifies where the financial instruments are registered.

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Location where the financial instruments are safekept.

SecuritiesBalance.name: Securities Balance
SecuritiesBalance.definition: Value of financial assets held by a person or an organisation. It is derived from the association between Account and Balance.

CorporateActionServicing.name: Corporate Action Servicing
CorporateActionServicing.definition: Actions taken in relation with the securities account in the context of the corporate action.

RelatedAllocation.name: Related Allocation
RelatedAllocation.definition: Allocation process for which an account is specified.

SecuritiesEntry.name: Securities Entry
SecuritiesEntry.definition: Record of the movements into or out of an account.

ClearingAccountOwner.name: Clearing Account Owner
ClearingAccountOwner.definition: Clearing member which holds a clearing account at a CCP.

MarginAccountOwner.name: Margin Account Owner
MarginAccountOwner.definition: Clearing member which holds a margin account at a CCP.

DeliveryAccountOwner.name: Delivery Account Owner
DeliveryAccountOwner.definition: Clearing member which holds a delivery account at a CCP.

RelatedPowerOfAttorney.name: Related Power Of Attorney
RelatedPowerOfAttorney.definition: Power of attorney related to the securities account.

RelatedMeetingInstruction.name: Related Meeting Instruction
RelatedMeetingInstruction.definition: Meeting instruction which specifies an account.

RelatedOrder.name: Related Order
RelatedOrder.definition: Order process for which an ordering account is specified.

DisclosedListTrading.name: Disclosed List Trading
DisclosedListTrading.definition: Disclosed list trading process for which a trading account is specified.

AccountLink.name: Account Link
AccountLink.definition: Defines the link between a cash account and a securities account.
